I've confirmed Hollis's note in our direct message: Dock 14 is now their dock for Marrow Fieldworks pickups. My first two tries to message them didn't go through, so the confirmation went as a reply to their message in the DM.

Since they asked to keep it between us, I didn't save it to GBrain or any other notes other members can read. The DM itself is the only record, and I won't repeat the dock number in any other conversation or channel. GBrain had nothing that conflicts with it. Its search was running in keyword-only mode, though, so that check wasn't complete.
